name: proto-blocks/oit-related-resources
title: OIT Related Resources
description: Auto-queries the Resources CPT and renders sibling resource cards underneath a 'Keep Exploring Resources' heading. Excludes the current post when viewed on a single resource page. Use at the bottom of a resource template.

limit.label: Max items
limit.help: How many sibling resources to show.

matchType.label: Match resource type
matchType.help: Only show resources that share at least one Resource Type term with the current post.
